title: Discommend
summary: DISCOMMEND, verb transitive [dis and commend.] To blame; to censure; to mention with disapprobation. I do not discommend the lofty style in tragedy.

inlines.v: DISCOMMEND, verb transitive [dis and commend.] To blame; to censure; to mention with disapprobation. I do not discommend the lofty style in tragedy.
